steps: Do not enter Law School Building 17 during the control period.
Keep noise low inside and outside the building.
Use another building if you need to meet someone there.
summary: Do not enter Law School Building 17 on 6–7 November 2026 unless you are involved in the exam, and keep noise down.
title: Avoid Law School Building 17 during entrance exams

english: Building access will be restricted for the 2027 admission screening for the professional master's program (Juris Doctor) of the School of Law (법학전문대학원). Please see the restrictions and requests for cooperation below, and help the admission process run smoothly.
Restricted area: all of Building 17 (17동), School of Law
가. During the restriction period, no one may enter the restricted area except people involved in the School of Law admission exam.
나. Please avoid making noise inside and outside the restricted area.
